defaults.motion_elements: the chalet lights and the falling snow
defaults.ambient: Snow falls. Clouds drift slowly past the peaks.

shots.subject: An alpine valley village of wooden chalets with glowing windows and lights along the eaves, a small church with an onion dome, snowy slopes and pink-tinged peaks above
A ski lodge terrace with snow-covered wooden tables and benches, a lantern glowing on each table, lights strung along the railing and the lit village and slopes below
shots.motion_elements: the table lanterns, the railing lights and the falling snow

shots.subject: A village church with a pointed steeple surrounded by snowy chalets at dusk, a lit tree in the little square and mountains glowing pink behind
A chalet balcony with carved wooden railings wrapped in lights, a pair of wooden skis leaning in the snow, a small lit tree in a pot and the valley village glowing below
The snowy main street of an alpine village lined with timber chalets and glowing shop windows, garlands of lights strung across the street, lanterns and a tall lit tree at the end
shots.focus: the lit tree down the street

shots.subject: A mountain lodge lounge with a tall stone chimney and a roaring fire, sheepskin-covered armchairs, a lit tree and floor-to-ceiling windows onto snowy slopes at dusk
shots.motion_elements: the fire, the tree lights and the snow outside the windows
shots.ambient: The fire flickers. Snow falls outside the windows.

shots.subject: Floodlit ski runs curving down a mountain into a cluster of lit chalets, a chairlift with lights on every pylon and a dark pine forest dusted with snow
A pair of old wooden skis and poles leaning against a chalet wall beside a lantern and a small wreath, fairy lights along the eaves above and snow falling
shots.motion_elements: the lantern flame, the fairy lights and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls. The lantern flame flickers.

shots.subject: A high aerial view of an alpine village in a snowy bowl, a winding lit road climbing to it, chalets glowing and forested slopes rising to peaks at blue hour
An outdoor ice rink in the centre of an alpine village, ringed with lights on wooden posts and a tall lit tree, chalets with glowing windows all around
shots.motion_elements: the rink lights, their reflections on the ice and the falling snow

shots.subject: A chalet front door with a heavy wreath, a lantern on each side, snow piled on the steps, a wooden sled leaning by the door and warm light in the small windows
shots.motion_elements: the lantern flames, the glowing windows and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls. The lantern flames flicker.

shots.subject: A lone chalet high on a snowy slope with every window glowing and a lit tree beside it, the valley village twinkling far below under pink peaks
A mug of mulled wine with a cinnamon stick on a snowy terrace table, steam rising, a lantern beside it and the lit village blurred far below
shots.motion_elements: the steam from the mug, the lantern and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Steam rises from the mug. Snow falls.

shots.subject: A chalet living room with pine walls, a lit tree, a woodstove burning and a large window onto the lit village and peaks at dusk
shots.motion_elements: the stove fire, the tree lights and the snow outside the window
shots.ambient: The woodstove fire flickers. Snow falls outside the window.

shots.subject: A mountain hut restaurant perched on a snowy ridge with lights along its roof and terrace, a lit tree by the door, a ski slope beside it and the last pink light on the peaks
A row of chalets along a frozen mountain stream crossed by a small covered wooden bridge wrapped in lights, their lit windows reflected in the ice
A chalet window with carved wooden shutters, a window box of pine and red berries, lights around the frame and a candle glowing behind the frosted glass, snow falling
shots.motion_elements: the candle flame, the window lights and the falling snow
shots.ambient: Snow falls. The candle flame flickers behind the glass.

shots.subject: A snowy meadow with a few scattered wooden barns strung with lights, the village and its church beyond and the peaks glowing pink
An alpine village square at dusk with a frozen stone fountain dressed in garland, a tall lit tree and wooden market stalls with lanterns
shots.motion_elements: the stall lanterns, the tree lights and the falling snow

shots.subject: Snow-laden pine branches hung with a few red baubles and warm lights beside a chalet, the valley village lights blurred below
shots.motion_elements: the branch lights and the falling snow
